name: trilly_pregrad_v7
lineage: successor to trilly_pregrad_v6/v6.1; honest-harness rebuild on the 30k graduation tapes

entry.fill: first post-grad swap >= grad+2s within 30s, reject if slip > 15% vs at-grad quote
entry.delay_refuted: entering grad+30..300s is monotonically WORSE; enter AT graduation

selection.model: 8-seed-bagged LightGBM regressor (predict realized $25 pnl under the exit)
selection.score: mean of predict() over the 8 boosters
selection.gate: trade if score >= 15.86012 (calibrated to ~top-25%/day = ~52 trades/day at ~209 enterable graduations/day)
selection.gate_adaptive_alt: or per-day top-25% by score (eval method)

exit.spec: RIDE: 30% trailing stop off the running post-grad max, hard 600s timer; NO fast scalp (post-grad open is a dump, win~30% — fast/cut is REFUTED)

sizing.cap: $100 (do NOT exceed; $200 is the impact-fragile zone)
sizing.depth_measure_live: graduation-instant AMM pool liquidity (soak must confirm it tracks eflow)

economics_walkforward_costhonest_8seed.basis: settle_engine honest fill+impact (2S/(S+flow))+1% fee; recent folds; depth-gated $100; top-25%

2x_impact_stress.note: stays POSITIVE & gate-passing; does NOT invert

caveats: RIGHT-TAIL-CARRIED: median trade LOSES (June -$5.4 @1x / -$7.7 @2x); top-5% of trades = 110-190% of profit. Moonshot-dependent.

BIRDEYE SURVIVORSHIP: 30k is a hand-picked graduate sample -> $/day is an optimistic ceiling; a Birdeye-trained model did NOT transfer to the live firehose (t120 lesson) -> RETRAIN on solanatrilly's own live AMM feed.
DEPTH-GATE is impact-fragile: the >$500 rests on $100 fills matching 2S/(S+flow); soak must log deep-book fills; $500 vs ~$350 live is a fill-quality question.
DECAY: lane faded Feb->Jun; recent fold is the only valid read; retrain frequently.
deployment_discipline: 1. OBSERVE soak at FLAT $25 first (impact-independent anchor ~$130-210/day). Confirm no inversion (project law).
2. Only then ramp to depth-gated $100 while logging reconstructed-firehose deep-book fills vs 2S/(S+flow).
3. Sizing MULTIPLIES the per-token edge; if selection inverts live, sizing amplifies the loss. Size is the LAST lever. Cap $100.
4. Grade on the post-grad TAPE + on-chain graduation, not dashboard PnL.
